name: dgames
description: Small browser games, one folder each. Every game is a single self-contained index.html.

dgames.comment: The only files the runner does not treat as gating tests. Everything else is discovered by walking <game>/test/*.js; nothing is listed here just to be found. `npm run test:all` runs these too.
dgames.reportOnlyComment: Tuning reports, not tests: they print a distribution and always exit 0, so they cannot fail a gate — they can only make one slower. balance.js auto-bats 20 innings of random physics and its runtime varies from about 50s to over 180s, which is a long time to spend learning nothing.
